body: The trial supervisor left application instructions on the porch. My brother mixed the concentrate without gloves that afternoon. By evening his hands were blistered and he couldn't stop shaking. I saved the instruction sheet when we left the house.
title: Field notebook page

body:
They told us the list was for families. I believed them until the families arrived and nobody would let them see it.

One woman recognized a coat through the window. The man at the door said the coat belonged to a different person and closed the curtain. She waited for hours because no one would tell her whose coat she had seen.

I wrote down the time they took the list. If she comes back I can at least tell her when we stopped being allowed to answer.
title: Handwritten letter
